title: Gurohe Chaak Gariban
body:
jo fatema ki rag e jaan ali ka hai dilbar
hussain minni kahe jisko shaafa e mehshar
wo jiska kar diya taraaj karbala mein ghar
musibaton ki hadein khatm ho gayi jis par
guroh e chaak gariban salaam karta hai
<<DIVIDER>>
qayam e sheh ka nigehban hussain ka bhai
wo jisne ki thi sakina ki ran mein saqqayi
lab e furaat kate haath jiske maut aayi
wafa ne jis se jahan mein hayaat e nau paayi
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
na maa ka doodh na pani mila jise wo sagheer
wo jisko dekh ke tukde jigar ho wo baysheer
wo jisko le gaye maidan mein hazrat e shabbir
wo jiska nanha gala aur hurmala ka teer
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
jo quwwat e dil e laila tha khoobroo wo jawan
wo jisko dekh ke hota tha mustafa ka gumaan
wo jisne ain e jawani mein khaayi dil pa sina
wo jiske byaah ka maadar ko reh gaya armaan
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
wohi jo thay shahe karbobala ke dil ka chain
wo kamsini mein jinhe maut aayi haye hussain
tha jinki maut se qaimon mein ek shor o shain
wo yani zainab e aali nasab ke noor e ain
guroh e chaak gariban...
<<DIVIDER>>
wo jisko seene pa apne sulaate thay sarwar
wo jiske kaano se tapka lahoo chinay gauhar
yateem jaan ke todi musibatein jis par
rahi aseeron ki jo shaam tak shareek e safar
guroh e chaak gariban...
